0.8.0 reached crates.io, PyPI and the GitHub release but not npm. 0.8.1 carries the same changes everywhere, so on npm `thetadatadx-ts` and `thetadatadx-mcp-server` go from 0.7.0 straight to 0.8.1. Those upgrading from 0.7.0 should read the [0.8.0 release notes](https://github.com/userFRM/ThetaDataDx/releases/tag/v0.8.0) first: they list the breaking changes and how to migrate.

## Changed

- **npm provenance on every package.** The npm packages are published through npm trusted publishing, so each of them, the platform packages included, carries a provenance attestation that ties it to the release workflow that built it.

## Fixed

- The warning logged when a buffered request returns a large response links the request-sizing guide instead of a path inside the source repository.
- The configuration guide names the `metrics-prometheus` cargo feature, which enables the Rust Prometheus exporter, instead of a `metrics` feature that does not exist.

There are no API changes from 0.8.0.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/userFRM/ThetaDataDx/blob/v0.8.1/CHANGELOG.md) for the details.
